title: Howling Cosmic Dog
description: A golden retriever sits on a wooden deck howling upwards with its head tilted back. Behind it is a large orange circular portal surrounded by teal geometric rings, alchemical symbols, floating eyes, a crescent moon, and a small astronaut figure connected by a tether.
prompt: A golden retriever sitting on a wooden deck howling at the sky, head tilted back dramatically. Behind the dog is a large orange circular portal with three floating eyeballs, surrounded by teal geometric rings containing alchemical symbols and text. A small astronaut figure floats to the left tethered by a line, with a crescent moon and purple mountains in the background, surreal cosmic occult scene in a detailed illustrative style.
